high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from techcrunch.com. The content of the article discusses a letter from the NAACP (National Association for the Advancement of Colored People) regarding the location of a facility called "Colossus" near South Memphis' Boxtown neighborhood. The NAACP describes the Boxtown neighborhood as "historically Black" and criticizes the location of the Colossus facility, stating that it perpetuates the trend of industries adding pollution to communities who do not cause the problem.
